title: Setup: Mini Xiangqi refuses its own start with Black to move
rationale: This is the frozen placement with the other side to move, and it is refused: the comparison is against the whole frozen FEN, so a game whose first mover is frozen has no second setup that differs only there. It is the nearest miss a setup a player could compose has, and the pin that keeps the per-game policy from widening to a game that has not defined a predicate.
